title: Storybound waypoint
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/waypoints/<path>.json — a waypoint every player may see: when its conditions pass and, if bound to a quest, while that quest is active (at stage, if given). Quest stages can also list waypoints.

color.description: The colour of the marker and its name, for a quest you do not track (the tracked quest's markers are always gold). Pick one or type #RRGGBB, e.g. #C0392B.

conditions.description: The marker shows only while these conditions hold (a flag is set, it is night...). Empty: always.

quest.description: The marker shows only while this quest is active. Empty: no quest needed. Often simpler: list the marker in the quest's stage instead (the stage's waypoints).

stage.description: With a quest: only while the quest is at this stage. Pick it from the quest's stages.

radius.description: A search area of this radius, in blocks (a block is a metre), instead of a point.

show_radius.description: For a search area: write its radius by the name.

show_ring.description: For a search area: draw its edge on the ground near the player.

style.description: How the marker looks: the quest marker (a diamond) or the character marker (small, its name only under the crosshair, up to 96 blocks). Resource packs can add more looks in assets/<namespace>/storybound/waypoint_styles/.

entity.description: Follows this entity (an NPC); while it is not loaded, its last known position is used.

structure.description: Marks the nearest such structure, or any of a #tag, searched in the background (like /locate) near each player; shown once found, never if none is within search_radius. It follows the player: when they travel into another 256-block area, a search from there runs in the background and the waypoint moves if that structure is at least 16 blocks nearer.

search_radius.description: In chunks, as /locate: the search costs more the larger it is, mostly when nothing is found.

origin.description: Searched from here, once for everyone, instead of near each player and again as they travel.

nearest.description: Points at the nearest living entity that matches, near each player who sees the waypoint: an entity type, a #tag or a list, or a selector ({ "type": "minecraft:wolf", "tag": "alpha" }). Only loaded entities count, players never; nothing shows while none is in range. A picked entity is kept while it lives and stays within 1.25 times the range, so the marker does not hop between two mobs.
